newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY - OPINION C-373/95 MASA - SOCIAL POLICY.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY - OPINION C-373/95 MASA - SOCIAL POLICY.

text.p: Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 80/987/EEC of October 20, 1980, on the approximation of member state legislation on protection of salaried workers in cases of employer bankruptcy. Modes of compensating individuals for the non transposition of a directive. System fixing a ceiling for damages. - Opinion C-28/96 Fricarnes - free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12 and 95 and article 33 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system - uniform basis of assessment. Tax on the slaughter and import of porcine, bovine, ovine and caprine meat and on the marketing of meats, intended to combat certain animal diseases. - Opinion C-153/96-P de Rijk v/ Commission - Statute of officials. Appeal against court decisions rendered March 7, 1996, in case T-362/94, M. De Rijk v/ Commission. Annulment of the decision refusing to repay the difference between medical costs for a child in charge that normally resides in an EU country and the sum reimbursed under general arrangements. - Oral procedure C-329/95 VAG Sverige - free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 70/156/EEC of February 6, 1970, on the approximation of legislation on the type approval of automotive vehicles and their trailers. National regulation subjecting the registration of a car for use in Sweden to the obligatory furnishing of a certificate for motor vehicle pollution levels. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-389/95 Klattner - taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 83/182/EEC of March 28, 1983, on tax exemptions within the EU for certain means of transport temporarily imported into one member state from another. Possibility for national authorities to restrict the number of vehicles to benefit. Principle of proportionality. Sanctions in case of breach. SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-463/93 St. Martinus Elten: agriculture. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 7 of Council regulation 857/84 of March 31, 1984, adopting general rules for the application of the levy referred to in Article 5c of regulation 804/68 in the milk and milk products sector, of article 5 of regulation 1371/84 of May 16, 1984, and of regulation 856/84 of March 31, 1984. Exploitation of farm lands rented in another member state. - Judgment C-29/95 Pastoors: principles of Community law. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 6 and Council regulations 3820/85 of December 20, 1985, on the approximation of certain provisions in the road transport sector, 3821/85 of December 20, 1985, on the recording equipment in road transport. Sanctions in cases of breach. National rules requiring in contested cases the provision of a financial guarantee by foreign parties only, including EU citizens. - Judgment C-171/95 Tetik: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1 of decision 1/80 of the EU/Turkey association council. Worker belonging to the regular work force of a member state. Turkish national employed on a boat flying a member state flag and subject to the law of said state as regards his work record, social security arrangements and income tax. Consequences of a voluntary termination of employment on a possible right of stay. - Judgment C-181/95 Biogen: approximation of legislation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 6 and 8, paragraph 1(b) of Council regulation 1768/92 of June 18, 1992, on the creation of a supplementary protection certificate for medicinal products. Rights of a patent holder vis-a-vis the holder of marketing authorisation. - Judgment C-314/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture. Non respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 92/45/EEC of June 16, 1992, on public health and animal health problems relating to the killing of wild game and the placing on the market of wild-game meat, 92/46/EEC of June 16, 1992, laying down the health rules for the production and placing on the market of raw milk, heat-treated milk and milk-based products, 92/65/EEC of July 13, 1992, laying down animal health requirements governing trade in and imports into the EU of animals, semen, ova and embryos not subject to animal health requirements laid down in specific EU rules referred to in annex A(I) of directive 90/425, 92/88/EEC of October 1992, amending directive 74/63/EEC on the fixing of maximum permitted levels for undesirable substances and products in animal feedingstuffs, 92/116/EEC of December 17, 1992, amending and updating directive 71/118/EEC on health problems affecting trade in fresh poultry meat, 92/117/EEC of December 17, 1992, on measures for protection against specified zoonoses and specified zoonotic agents in animals and products of animal origin in order to prevent outbreaks of food-borne infections and intoxications, 92/118/EEC of December 17, 1992, laying down animal health and public health requirements governing trade in and imports into the EU of products not subject to the said requirements laid down in specific EU rules referred to in annex A(I) of directive 89/662/EEC and, as regards pathogens, in directive 90/425/EEC. - Oral procedure C-266/95 Merino Garcia: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of annex I,1.C(a) of Council regulation 1408/71 of June 14, 1971, on social security schemes for employed persons and their families moving within the EU as amended and updated by Council regulation 2001/83 of June 2, 1983. Scope of application regarding German family benefits. Worker on unpaid leave of absence. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-285/95 Kol: external relations. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 6, paragraph 1 and 14 of Council decision 1/80 of the EEC/Turkey association council. Worker. Right of stay. Regular employment. Stay permit obtained on the basis of knowingly given false declarations and constituting a breach. Deportation. General measures of prevention.
